class.name: ActivityProxy
class.brief_description: ContextProxy entry held by ActivityManager's back-stack.
class.description: Created by [method Context.start_activity] and pushed into the stack synchronously. While the activity scene is still loading, the proxy is the only thing in the stack — [method get_activity] returns [code]null[/code] until [signal ContextProxy.ready] fires.

method.name: get_activity
method.description: Returns the attached [Activity], or [code]null[/code] while loading.

method.name: has_pending_new_intent
method.description: True if a SINGLE_TOP/CLEAR_TOP retarget arrived while this proxy was still LOADING. ActivityManager applies it once the activity is READY.
